description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

                  id="Definitions_CreditScoring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotification" name="Delay notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank" processRef="Process_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ScoringRequest"
                      name="Scoring request"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest"
                      targetRef="StartEvent_ScoringRequest"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotification"
                      name="Delay notification"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotification"
                      targetRef="Event_CatchDelayNotification"
                      messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ImmediateResult"
                      name="Scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult"
                      targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Level2Result"
                      name="Scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"
                      targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Bank" name="Banking process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Bank">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesClerk" name="Sales clerk">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_CreditScoringRequested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BankingSystem" name="Banking system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendScoringRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CatchDelayNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DisplayDelayMessage</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CatchImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CatchLevel2Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeScoringResults</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DisplayScoringResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ScoringPresented</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreditScoringRequested" name="Credit-scoring requested via frontend"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendScoringRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" name="Wait for agency response" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchDelayNotification" name="Delay notification received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DelayNotification" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DisplayDelayMessage" name="Display delay message to clerk"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchImmediateResult" name="Scoring result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchLevel2Result" name="Scoring result received after level 2">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Level2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeScoringResults" name="Scoring result available"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DisplayScoringResult" name="Display scoring result at frontend"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ScoringPresented" name="Scoring result presented"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreditScoringRequested" targetRef="Task_SendScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_2" sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_3" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchDelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_5" sourceRef="Event_CatchDelayNotification" targetRef="Task_DisplayDelayMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_6" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelayMessage" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_7" sourceRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult" targetRef="Gateway_MergeScoringResults"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_8" sourceRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" targetRef="Gateway_MergeScoringResults"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_9" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeScoringResults" targetRef="Task_DisplayScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_10" sourceRef="Task_DisplayScoringResult" targetRef="EndEvent_ScoringPresented"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Agency scoring process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ScoringRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ScoringOutcome" name="Can the result be determined immediately?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendImmediateResult" name="Send scoring result to banking system"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayNotification" name="Inform banking system of delay"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2Result" name="Send scoring result to banking system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeAgencyOutcomes" name="Scoring outcome complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_AgencyComplete" name="Scoring information sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ScoringRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_ScoringOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_3" name="Result determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_ScoringOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_4" name="Result takes longer" sourceRef="Gateway_ScoringOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendDelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_5" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotification" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_6" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_7" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAgencyOutcomes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_8" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAgencyOutcomes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_9" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeAgencyOutcomes" targetRef="EndEvent_AgencyComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
